lines.zh: 我踩着枝叶走，身体很轻。
lines.en: I walk on the branches, light on my feet.

lines.zh: 我一路只留下很浅的印。
lines.en: I leave only the faintest prints.

lines.zh: 我在树干之间一跳一跳。
lines.en: I hop between the trunks.

lines.zh: 我身上像披了一层叶子。
lines.en: I'm draped in what looks like leaves.
I work my way up through the jungle.

lines.zh: 我的手里握着一枚手里剑。
lines.en: I hold a shuriken in my hand.

lines.zh: 我走得很静，几乎没声音。
lines.en: I move very quietly.
I pass under the vines.

lines.zh: 我停在树杈上，稳住重心。
lines.en: I stop on a forked branch and settle.

lines.zh: 我的手臂一甩，抓住上面的枝。
lines.en: I swing an arm up and catch a branch.

lines.zh: 我沿着一根枝挪到尽头。
lines.en: I edge along a branch to its end.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枝上，一动不动的。
lines.en: I crouch on the branch without moving.
The leaves on me rustle faintly.
I roll my wrist slowly.

lines.zh: 手里剑在指间转了一圈。
lines.en: My shuriken turns once between my fingers.
I hold my breath in my chest, still.
I flatten onto the branch.
A bird settles nearby.
I'm counting, unhurried.

lines.zh: 树叶遮住了我半个身子。
lines.en: Leaves hide half of me.
I grip my shuriken again.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩到叶子后面。
lines.en: I draw myself behind the leaves.
I glance below once more.
You've come up here.
I turn slowly to look at you.
My shuriken is still in hand.

lines.zh: 我身上这些叶子不是装饰。
lines.en: These leaves on me aren't decoration.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，除非你先动。
lines.en: No ill intent — unless you move first.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我已经换了位置。
lines.en: While you looked up, I already moved.
My crouch is steady.
I look slowly down.
Go if you want to go.
I stand the shuriken between my fingers.
Leaf by leaf, I'm hidden.
Shuriken hang all over me.
I quietly shift my angle.

lines.zh: 我一下弹到另一根枝上。
lines.en: I spring to another branch.
I've lost a good few leaves.

lines.zh: 忍者兽退了半步，稳住了。
lines.en: Shurimon takes half a step and holds.
I make no sound. I count to ten.
I press against the trunk.
My hand shakes; the shuriken sits crooked.
I quietly tighten my grip on the shuriken.
I've noted where you stand.
Is that food in your hand?

lines.zh: 我慢慢从树上下来一点。
lines.en: I come down the tree a little.
First I check it's not a trick.
I reach out and take it.
I'd rather eat up in the tree.
I push a leaf aside.
Back off two steps and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 这个味道让我想起训练。
lines.en: This taste reminds me of training.
I hold my hand out again.
We're both crowded on this branch.
I'm lighter — easier to dodge.
I hook the branch with my toes and hold.
I swing past your side.

lines.zh: 看清了，这是一枚会拐弯的飞镖。
lines.en: Watch closely — this shuriken can curve.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我的刃不认人。
lines.en: Don't crowd me — my blades don't check names.

lines.zh: 碰一下就算切磋，我可没收手。
lines.en: One bump counts as a spar — I didn't hold back.

lines.zh: 森林里走路，记得抬头看镖。
lines.en: Walking in the jungle? Remember to look up for shuriken.
I have no comrade in this wood.
I remember where I trained.
The trees there were taller.

lines.zh: 我练了一整天的手里剑。
lines.en: I trained all day with shuriken.
My master said to be still.
I'm very still now.
I flip my shuriken over.
Only wind in the wood.

lines.zh: 我又跳到了另一根枝上。
lines.en: I hop to another branch.
It is nearly dark.

lines.zh: 指缝夹紧了，像夹一枚镖。
lines.en: Pinned between my fingers like a dart.

lines.zh: 我一身忍者装，手里剑不离手。
lines.en: Ninja garb, shuriken always in hand.

lines.zh: 我把它压在忍装的内侧。
lines.en: I tuck it inside my ninja garb.
I missed, flipped my hand, and caught it.
I hop down to get it.
This weighs almost nothing.
I stick it in the fork of a branch.
I'll find a use for it.
Something moves under the tree.
I tighten my grip on the shuriken.

lines.zh: 我在算跳到那里的距离。
lines.en: I'm judging the jump down.
The leaves hide me from it.
My shuriken is aimed at it.
I've picked the steadiest branch.
The wind's from behind it.
I flatten my body into a line.
This branch is the right height.
I count slowly to three.
It's turned its back this way.
I track it along the branches.
It goes left; I hop left.
I'm nearly silent.
I've changed branch.
I've memorized its line.
I close in branch by branch.

lines.zh: 我蹲在最外的那根枝上。
lines.en: I crouch on the outermost branch.
There's a good angle down there.
It's stopped to drink.
I raise my shuriken.
I move to a new spot among the branches.

lines.zh: 我一甩手，手里剑飞出去。
lines.en: I flick my hand and the shuriken flies.
It hits the mark.
I leap down and strike again.
That one used my foot.
It backed off and I leapt back up.
My leaves scattered.
That throw went wide.
I change position around it.
I've drawn another.
It blocked.
I spring back a step.
My hand never stopped moving.
I drop out of the leaves.
All I see is trees and leaves.
I settle on a branch.
My shuriken is still with me.
I settle my leaves straight.
The trees are dense here.
I hear insects.
I test the branch under me.
From this height I can see far.
I hop up one more level.
The leaves sway; I hold still.

lines.zh: 火燎到叶子，我一弹就躲开了。
lines.en: Fire catches my leaves and I spring clear.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，摔在落叶上。
lines.en: I fall from the branch into the leaf litter.
Water floods in and I can't struggle.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从树上掀下来。
lines.en: The blast blows me out of the tree.

lines.zh: 我身上的叶子开始发热。
lines.en: The leaves on me are heating up.
I've no strength left to jump.

lines.zh: 脚下没有枝了，我一直往下。
lines.en: No branch under me; I fall and fall.
